effect.name: GM Text Glitch
effect.desc: A bursty corruption, not a constant noise. A burst clock decides WHEN the text is attacked; between bursts the text is untouched. Inside a burst four independent strikes fire on their own hashed blocks: whole blocks of characters are displaced (the sliced-and-reglued datamosh look), individual glyphs are swapped for a chosen pool, characters stutter by repeating themselves, and characters drop out entirely. Every strike is hashed from the burst index, so no two bursts are alike, and nothing is random - a preview and an export produce exactly the same frames. The clock runs on the LAYER's own time, so the corruption travels with the layer.
